name: OutsideCounselPanelManager
tagline: Run your law-firm panel – RFPs, rates, allocation, scorecards and audit letters – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete outside counsel panel management app for in-house legal teams: panel firms and tiers, rate cards and rate-increase requests against a cap, the RFP and appointment pipeline, matter allocation with transparent fit scoring, weighted scorecards, audit letter requests, renewals, PI insurance, engagement letters and off-panel leakage. Works instantly with demo data and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, Excel, SQL or Power Pages without JSON.
features: Matter allocation fit score with blockers
Rate requests vs cap: approve / counter / reject
Renewals, PI insurance and engagement-letter compliance
Bulk actions, filters, grouping, CSV export, undo
Phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
